definitions.explanation: An accident involving vehicles on a road, including collisions, pedestrian accidents, and other road incidents.

examples.japanese: {交通事故|こうつうじこ}に{遭|あ}った。
examples.english: I was in a traffic accident.

examples.japanese: {交通事故|こうつうじこ}で{渋滞|じゅうたい}が{発生|はっせい}している。
examples.english: A traffic jam has occurred due to a traffic accident.

examples.japanese: {飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}による{交通事故|こうつうじこ}が{後|あと}を{絶|た}たない。
examples.english: Traffic accidents caused by drunk driving are never-ending.

notes:
The standard term for any road traffic accident. Frequently appears in news reports and daily conversation. In Japan, even minor fender-benders are typically reported to the police.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交通事故|こうつうじこ}に{遭|あ}う: to be in a traffic accident
- {交通事故|こうつうじこ}を{起|お}こす: to cause a traffic accident
- {交通事故|こうつうじこ}{現場|げんば}: accident scene
- {交通事故|こうつうじこ}{証明書|しょうめいしょ}: traffic accident certificate
- {死亡|しぼう}{交通事故|こうつうじこ}: fatal traffic accident

RELATED WORDS:
- {人身事故|じんしんじこ}: accident involving personal injury — often heard in train delay announcements
- {物損事故|ぶっそんじこ}: property-damage-only accident — no injuries involved
- {追突事故|ついとつじこ}: rear-end collision
